Linear for Antigravity

Bring your Linear workspace into Antigravity

Find issues, manage projects, and keep your work up to date.
Connect your code to the work happening in Linear.

## Overview The Linear plugin connects Antigravity to your Linear workspace. Find issues, read project updates, and create or update issues and documents without leaving your development workflow. The plugin uses [Linear's hosted MCP server](https://linear.app/docs/mcp). Sign in with your Linear account to get started. No API key or local server is required. ## Quick start ### 1. Install from the marketplace Open **Customizations → Plugins** in Antigravity, find **Linear** in the marketplace, and click **Install**. ### 2. Connect your Linear account **Installing the plugin is the first step. Connect your account before using Linear tools.** 1. Open **Agent settings → Customizations** (`Cmd+,` on macOS). 2. Click **Authenticate** next to the plugin's Linear MCP server. 3. Sign in to Linear in your browser and authorize your workspace. 4. Copy the authorization code shown after approval. 5. Return to Antigravity, paste the code into the authentication field in settings, and click **Submit**. Paste the code into settings, not agent chat. Antigravity reconnects the server after authentication and refreshes expired access tokens automatically. ### 3. Try it out Ask Antigravity: > Show my assigned Linear issues, grouped by priority. Once Antigravity retrieves your issues from Linear, you're connected. You can also try: - Summarize recent updates to my Linear projects. - Find Linear issues related to the code I am working on. - Create a Linear issue for the bug we just found. - Add a progress update to the issue I am working on. ## Troubleshooting ### Installed, but Linear tools are unavailable Check that the plugin is enabled, then open **Agent settings → Customizations** and authenticate its Linear MCP server. Installation does not sign you in automatically. ### Browser sign-in finished, but Antigravity is still waiting Copy the authorization code from the browser, return to the authentication field in Antigravity settings, and click **Submit**. This manual handoff is part of [Antigravity's OAuth flow](https://antigravity.google/docs/mcp#oauth). ### The connection stopped working Refresh or reconnect the Linear MCP server in Antigravity. Complete authentication again if prompted. For workspace access and authentication help, see the [Linear MCP documentation](https://linear.app/docs/mcp). ## Development For local installation, package details, and release validation, see [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md).
